# Semantic listing fixtures

These are synthetic, dependency-free fixtures based on the nested-div structure observed in public category HTML. They are not archived complete IKEA pages and do not imply guaranteed site support.

- `page-1.html`: 24 products, BAGGEBO/PÄRKLA examples, visible 24-of-351 copy and a fragment-bearing page-2 link.
- `page-2.html`: the next 24 products and a next link.
- `final-page.html`: 15 products and no next link.

Image addresses and product URLs are placeholders. Product numbers in these fixtures are synthetic IDs. No review/rating markup is required. Hidden visual and accessible price copies represent one offer. The test generator separately creates all 351 logical products across 15 pages, with page-8 price and page-12 addition/removal cases.
